performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

<!-- agent-note:v1 -->
**Agent note — ported onto current main across the crate split (task 15861, lane any-d, 2026-11-13)**

This PR's original commit (8ae8bd294d) predated the pkgs/id crate split and no longer applied to main. It has been ported in a dedicated worktree and this branch force-updated (force-with-lease against 8ae8bd294d) to the ported head **9650bf7197** — a single commit on current main (46bf43a5fd) with the same change, re-seamed:

- `StoreError::MissingBody` lands in `pkgs/id/crates/id-store/src/event_types.rs` (the StoreError enum's post-split home).
- The SharedEventStore `range_body` / `range_ingest_with_bodies` surface lands in `pkgs/id/crates/id-store/src/store_traits.rs` over the generic EventStoreBackend seam: two new backend methods (`stored_body`, `ingest_events_with_bodies`), delegated by the id-events `EventStore` backend impl. The old `range_ingest_events` had no other callers and is replaced, as in the original commit. `pkgs/id/src/store_traits.rs` stays the re-export facade.
- The event_store changes land in `pkgs/id/crates/id-events/src/event_store/{mod,ingest,sync}.rs`, reconciled with main's current ingest flow: the verified body passes through `ingest_event` into the shared `ingest_in` path (which stores bodies in-transaction), while writer-body retention and device-op recording (#5656) are unchanged. The ported test constructor gains the `chat` field main added to ChainExt.

Verification on the laptop at head 9650bf7197:
- `cargo check -p id-events -p id-store` — pass
- `cargo test -p id-events event_store` — **140 passed, 0 failed** (incl. test_a_body_is_stored_at_ingest_and_read_back_byte_identically, test_a_missing_body_is_a_typed_not_found, test_a_body_arriving_after_its_header_is_stored, test_a_batch_body_that_is_not_the_committed_one_refuses_its_event)
- `cargo check -p id` — pass (the id build without the world feature)

No prior review findings existed on this PR to disposition (no formal reviews; CodeRabbit skipped the old head). Merging on local verification per standing fleet practice while Actions checks are stalled fleet-wide.
